title: Zone loss: 105% required
description: Illustrative capacity calculation, not observed data or a benchmark. The two categories are '3 zones: normal' at 70% required utilization per zone and '2 survivors: same load' at 105% required utilization per surviving zone. All zones have identical capacity, load is shared equally and scales linearly, total demand is unchanged, and retries are not included. 70% x 3 / 2 = 105% of one zone's capacity: required load exceeds available capacity by 5 percentage points, not measured CPU utilization above 100%. The 100% gridline represents one full zone's capacity. Category labels are shortened to keep the shared chart helper's labels horizontal.
